name: Home
purpose: Where the app opens: two options only, Manual and Projects

name: Manual
purpose: The owner's manual for this car: every fact, detail, model, repair and bit of history, perfectly organised - the tool he wishes he had when he started on the car

name: Car state
purpose: What the car is right now: identity and odometer with Log drive and Set odo, what is due, known faults, then each system
note: D-417. 00-CAR vehicle, drives, service, intervals, issues, systems - verified rows only

name: Diagrams
purpose: The car's diagrams: factory circuits, harness legs, boards, photos
note: D-417. 01-REFERENCE factory-circuits and photos, grouped by system; the factory scans go when the electrical project completes (his 5.6)

name: Service
purpose: The service log - the one history the Manual keeps (his 5.7) - and each interval with its next due

name: Specs
purpose: Every number about the car, searchable, filtered by system or category, each with its source
note: D-417. 00-CAR specs - only rows for this car as it is now

name: Projects
purpose: The project hub: start a new project or work on a current one

name: New project
purpose: Start a project
note: D-406: a name and one paragraph of goal; Claude opens the area

name: A project
purpose: One project's own home: where it stands and what waits on whom

name: Blocks
purpose: One block at a time, laid out for reading, with an answer box and buttons to explain it or discuss it first
note: from chat 2026-09-24, the first example he gave

name: Picks
purpose: One product suggestion at a time, answered yes, no or with a question

name: TODO
purpose: What can start today, then the rest in working order

name: Decisions
purpose: Every ruling, searchable, grouped by system

name: Run
purpose: Buttons that start the Claude Code workflows and show their reports

name: Parts
purpose: The project's parts table: one part per line, filterable, each row openable

name: Search
purpose: One box that finds anything anywhere - decisions, blocks, work, parts, any row - from every screen (Ctrl K)

name: Settings
purpose: The record's health, the tree folder on the desktop, the GitHub key on the phone

name: A decision
purpose: One decision in full: its text, what it replaced, what cites it

name: A record row
purpose: Any row of any table, opened from search or a link

name: Systems
purpose: The book view: system, then subsystem, then each part

name: The car
purpose: The location view: the car's zones on the 3D renders, each opening the parts that sit there
note: D-417. 00-CAR zones, parts; the S-037 renders

name: A part
purpose: One part: where it is, maker and part number with their links, every spec with its source, its service, the diagrams it appears on

name: Ask
purpose: Select any words and ask Claude about exactly them; computed answers saved as presets later
